hero.badge: 0% Admin Fee · 100% Direct Vendor Escrow · Punjab, Pakistan
hero.headline: Sacred Trust. Direct Impact for Families in Punjab.
hero.subcopy: Every Zakat and Sadaqah rupee goes directly to verified hospitals, pharmacies, schools, ration depots, and wedding essentials vendors—never raw cash, always backed by field visits and QR-verifiable receipts.

campaigns.title: Active Collective Crowdfunding Drives
campaigns.subtitle: Pool Zakat and Sadaqah across high-impact district drives with live Target vs. Collected tracking and named vendor escrow.

cases.title: Field-Verified Individual Cases
cases.subtitle: Only cases inspected on the ground by Accredited Field Verifiers and approved by the Verification Board appear here. No personal names or CNICs are ever exposed.

pipeline.title: 5-Stage Direct Vendor Escrow Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: How Amanat guarantees zero leakage from your pocket to a deserving household's vendor invoice.

stages.title: Field Visit
stages.desc: Accredited local verifier visits household in Punjab & uploads GPS/Tehsil evidence offline.

stages.title: Board Audit
stages.desc: Shariah & Verification Board audits vendor pro-forma invoice and anonymizes family identity.

stages.title: Donor Escrow
stages.desc: Donors transfer via zero-fee Raast, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, or Meezan IBAN and upload slip.

stages.title: Direct Vendor Payout
stages.desc: Confirmed funds are paid strictly to the hospital, school, ration depot, or wedding vendor.

stages.title: Paid Receipt & QR Certificate
stages.desc: Signed vendor receipt closes the loop and unlocks a downloadable QR PDF Amanat Certificate.

payment.title: Direct Escrow Contribution
payment.subtitle: Zero-fee transfer directly to Amanat Vendor Escrow
payment.successSub: Your pledge is live on the card's gold pending bar and queued for instant Board verification.

beneficiary.title: Request Dignified Assistance
beneficiary.subtitle: Your personal identity is kept strictly confidential and never shown publicly. All support is settled directly with your named hospital, school, or vendor.

verifier.title: Field Verifier Offline-First Workspace
verifier.subtitle: Inspect assigned rural Punjab households even without mobile data. Evidence is compressed and stored in IndexedDB for 1-tap sync.
verifier.attachPhotos: Attach Compressed CNIC / Vendor Invoice Photo

admin.title: Verification & Crowdfunding Board
admin.subtitle: Manage simultaneous crowdfunding drives, accredit field verifiers, confirm donor references, and upload final paid vendor receipts.

footer.zeroCost: Built on 100% zero-cost open-source & free-tier architecture · No platform fees · Punjab, Pakistan
